release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.4.5 — Tactile Skeuomorphic Redesign & Guardian Engine:
• Redesigned Study Guardian Active Overlay: High-craft circular halo emblem with concentric glow, live floating '● FOCUS GUARDIAN ACTIVE' status pill, and 3D tactile skeuomorphic buttons.
• Fixed Redirection Bug: Native overlay barrier strictly stays active until student explicitly taps 'Solve Quick MCQ to Unlock' or parent enters PIN — eliminates unintended auto-navigation.
• 0 Credit Starting Balance: Default initial balance is now strictly 0 pts. Students must earn credits through focused study sessions and NCERT curriculum drills.
• Student Guarded Apps Screen: Dedicated view for students to review guarded apps, live unlock statuses, and parent PIN authorizations.
• Parent App Restrictions Suite: Added quick batch 'Guard All' / 'Unguard All' toggles and an 'Add App' modal supporting popular distractors (Roblox, Discord, Twitter/X, Telegram, Pinterest, Twitch, Netflix, Prime Video, Clash of Clans) with instant native service synchronization.
• Tactile Skeuomorphic Component System: Apple HIG specular hairlines, physical 3D button shelves, and ambient multi-colored glow on all cards and interactive components.
